profiles.description: Reversible query routing defaults; not a latency guarantee. LatestJoin applies to identity selection. DisabledSchemas matches physical schema names.

Read-only ready-index routing. DisabledFlows is matched after schema-name normalization. CatalogCacheSeconds is an absolute shared-cache TTL, clamped to at least one second; zero does not disable caching. No setting enables DDL.

Each decoded scalar operand is limited independently, including elements of in/nin and endpoints of between. Length uses .NET string.Length (UTF-16 code units), not UTF-8 bytes or serialized JSON escape length. Includes object payloads keep their own budget. The existing 5000-character filter-string limit still applies. Stored instance values are not truncated or limited by this query-input rule.

Bounds on the asynchronous function-execution journal (functions with executionLog: ENABLED — see feature functionExecutionMetrics). A non-blocking producer enqueues on a bounded in-process channel and a single background writer drains it in batches; when the queue is full the NEWEST record is dropped (counted and reported via WorkflowLogs FunctionExecutionJournalRecordsDropped). So journal completeness is best-effort and bounded under sustained load — a domain enabling executionLog cannot assume 100% of invocations are recorded. This is not a latency guarantee and does not affect function execution time (the write is off the request path). Fixed constants, not configurable in this phase.
